liebermann.notes: Henry of Huntingdon, early 13th century, followed at f. 79v by the Tripartita (Wl art, ECf retr) and the Genealogia Normannica with readings like Lb; then f. 86 'Hic est annus qui comprehendit' from Huntingdon VIII and f. 87 bishop lists from William of Malmesbury's Gesta Pontificum, continued to the early 13th century. Arnold calls it a 'transcript of Lb'.

entries.text_de: London Lambeth 179, Anfang 13. Jhs.: Henr. Huntendon.13 Dahinter f. 79b Tripartita, d. i. Wl art, u. S. 486, ECf retr, u. S. 627, und Geneal. Normann. Lesarten wie Lb. Dahinter f. 86 Hic est annus qui comprehendit aus Huntingdon. VIII1; f. 87 Bischofslisten, aus Will. Malmesbir. G. Pontif., theilweise fortgesetzt bis Anfang 13. Jhs.
entries.text_en: London Lambeth 179, beginning of the 13th century: Henr. Huntendon.13 After it f. 79b Tripartita, i.e. Wl art, below, p. 486, ECf retr, below, p. 627, and Geneal. Normann. Readings as Lb. After that f. 86 Hic est annus qui comprehendit from Huntingdon VIII1; f. 87 lists of bishops, from Will. Malmesbir. G. Pontif., partly continued to the beginning of the 13th century.

notes.text_de: vgl. Arnold p. xl: ‘transcript of Lb’.
notes.text_en: cf. Arnold p. xl: ‘transcript of Lb’.

transcription.doubts: Runs from the foot of p. xxxii col. 2 to the top of p. xxxiii col. 1; footnote 1 is on p. xxxiii.
